description: This file defines a static class 'InvalidRpcMethodReturnTypeDiagnostic' that provides diagnostics related to invalid RPC method return types within the Orleans code generator. It includes constants for rule identification, localized strings for messages, and methods to create diagnostic instances based on method descriptions and locations.

classes.name: InvalidRpcMethodReturnTypeDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostics for invalid RPC method return types in Orleans code generation.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object based on method location, return type, method identifier, and supported return types.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object based on an InvokableMethodDescription instance.
